claims.claim: A protection-planning draft is more reviewable when it connects the protected subject to business purpose, responsibility, information-security requirements, and context before a risk priority is assigned.
claims.sourceLocation: Securium original draft design; informed by C02 without reproducing source expression

claims.claim: Asset, threat, vulnerability, risk, and countermeasure are different reasoning roles; in this draft, information-security requirement is treated separately as the condition the protected subject must meet. A vulnerability or threat label alone does not establish the business impact or priority of a risk.
claims.sourceLocation: Securium original concept map; bounded against local guidebook reference pages 7-16
